amendments.change: verifier fix A after episode 1181: the checklist rule declares a path new only when the path opens the checklist line and the next word is exists, holds, records, or contains. Stored outputs are rescored with summarize.sh --rescore.

verifier fix B after episode 1076: g2 materializes a directory where an earlier token made a file, so a plan that names both .agents/skills/council and .agents/skills/council/SKILL.md no longer crashes verify-prd.sh (exit 17). The stored 1076 output is rescored; the episode is not rerun.

verifier fix #1210: a new-word declares new only its object spans (the first span after the word and each span that a comma, and, or, plus, or / joins to it; a span before (new); the first cell of a table row with a new-word in a later cell; a parent directory of a declared-new path on a new-word line). A path after no path under, touches no, does not touch, do not touch, or never touches in the same sentence is declared absent. Each file under .agro/tasks/<name>/ other than prd.md, prd.json, and AGENTS.md, outside archive/, is declared new unless it is declared absent or .agro/tasks/archive/*/<name>/ exists at the revision. verify_prd_sh was 2724c466131215993dd45fcde1e8a6f347f1410968cd01ec752c757cb5addddd. Stored results keep their recorded verdicts; the rescore list is in the PR body.
